end.summary:
Recognised that families can differ in size and members.
Identified household tasks done by different family members.
Explained that sharing work prevents one person from becoming too tired.
Initially said children cannot help, then named picking up toys and bringing a small bottle of water as ways to help.
Teach-back was not passed; the final response again said they could do nothing because they are small.
end.parentNote: Asha practised how families can have different members and how sharing household work helps prevent one person from becoming too tired. Trisha gave examples such as bringing water, picking up toys, and helping Dadi, and later corrected the idea that children cannot help by naming these tasks. At the end, they again said they could do nothing, so please practise choosing one safe household task they can do each day, such as putting away toys or bringing a small bottle of water.
